_: hindi-ids.json — the number in each Hindi note's id, pinned to its note: <deck id> → <key> → N, for the id u_<deck id>_N. The key is a word card's Word, a letter's Letter, a reading rule's Key. A note of these decks is one note with two card templates, so both of a word's cards hang off this number (the English → Hindi card is <id>~2). Seeded on 2026-11-19 from the seven decks as shipped and APPLIED by hindi-fix.js: a rebuilt deck, which the generator numbers by position, is numbered back. NEVER delete or renumber a row — the Update press merges a reader's progress by id. A note the record removes moves to _retired; a new note takes the next free number; a respelling renames the key.
